info.title: GophKeeper API
info.description:
Complete API for GophKeeper - a secure password manager with client-server architecture.

## Features
- **OAuth2 Authentication**: Secure token-based authentication using Resource Owner Password Credentials and Refresh Token flows
- **Encrypted Data Storage**: Store credentials, text notes, bank cards, and binary files with client-side encryption
- **Data Synchronization**: Sync your data across multiple devices with conflict resolution
- **User Management**: Profile management, password change, and account deletion

## Authentication
Most endpoints require authentication using OAuth 2.0 Bearer tokens. Include the access token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

## Data Types
- **Credentials**: Login/password pairs for websites and services
- **Texts**: Encrypted text notes and secure information
- **Cards**: Bank card information (card number, CVV, expiry date)
- **Binaries**: Encrypted files and documents (max 10MB per file)

## Rate Limiting
API requests are subject to rate limiting to prevent abuse. Default limits apply per user account.

## Timestamps
All timestamps follow ISO 8601 format in UTC timezone.

v1TokenGrantType.description:
TokenGrantType enumerates supported OAuth2 grant types.

 - TOKEN_GRANT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED: TOKEN_GRANT_TYPE_UNSPECIFIED is an unknown grant type.
 - TOKEN_GRANT_TYPE_PASSWORD: TOKEN_GRANT_TYPE_PASSWORD is Resource Owner Password Credentials grant.
 - TOKEN_GRANT_TYPE_REFRESH_TOKEN: TOKEN_GRANT_TYPE_REFRESH_TOKEN is Refresh Token grant.

v1TokenTypeHint.description:
TokenTypeHint provides a hint for token revocation.

 - TOKEN_TYPE_HINT_ACCESS_TOKEN: TOKEN_TYPE_HINT_ACCESS_TOKEN hints an access token.
 - TOKEN_TYPE_HINT_REFRESH_TOKEN: TOKEN_TYPE_HINT_REFRESH_TOKEN hints a refresh token.
